name: Shattered Queen
definitionRules: Summon a 15 HP / 4 Power Thrall. Attacks hit ALL enemies and apply 1 Chill.
rules: Summon Shattered Queen: 15 HP / 4 Power. Attacks hit ALL enemies and apply 1 Chill. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
displayRules:
Summon a Thrall. 15 HP / 4 Power.
Attacks hit ALL enemies and apply 1 Chill.
Rot starts at 1.
If you have 3 Corpses, spend them instead of Mana.
